notes.title: Update 0.0001
notes.content:
Thank you for your support, we have made several updates in recent days
1. Based on feedback from players in different regions, a large number of translations have been modified
2. The scene has been modified
3. Tasks have been streamlined
4. The requirements for prop production have been reduced.
5. Fixed some bugs
6. Added magic spells
7.Added some clothes
8. The conflict between hairstyles 1 and 2 has been corrected, and the icon of hairstyle 2 has been changed.
Thank you for your feedback
We will do better in the future
